ToxicDart.name: Toxic Dart
ToxicDart.description: Projectile that deals damage and applies poison over time. Shoots closest unpoisoned enemy.

ShadowStrike.name: Shadow Strike
ShadowStrike.description: Teleport behind furthest enemy and deal damage

Cleave.name: Cleave
Cleave.description: Cleaves nearby enemies and applies bleed

Stomp.name: Stomp
Stomp.description: Stomps the ground, dealing damage to nearby enemies and knocking them back

SteelPlume.name: Steel Plume
SteelPlume.description: Shoot piercing projectile to closest enemy.

VenomFang.name: Venom Fang
VenomFang.description: Strike 3 close enemies. Apply poison and bleed.
VenomFang.level1: 3 damage. 4 damage/s bleed for 4s. 2 damage/s poison for 10s
VenomFang.level2: 9 damage. 10 damage/s bleed for 4s. 5 damage/s poison for 10s.
VenomFang.level3: 25 damage. 18 damage/s bleed for 4s. 12 damage/s poison for 10s.

IronWing.name: Iron Wing
IronWing.description: Strike enemies in the cone, target closest enemy. Gain shield for each enemy hit.

DragonBreath.name: Dragon Breath
DragonBreath.description: Hit enemies in the wide cone, deal increased damaged if target is poisoned.

Tremor.name: Tremor
Tremor.description: Hit enemies in line toward closest enemy. Medium range. Damage, slow, apply bleed.
Tremor.level1: 3 damage. 30% slow 3 seconds. 4 damage/s bleed for 4s.
Tremor.level2: 7 damage. 40% slow 4 seconds. 8 damage/s bleed for 4s.
Tremor.level3: 15 damage. 60% slow 6 seconds. 15 damage/s bleed for 4s.

PhoenixDive.name: Phoenix Dive
PhoenixDive.description: Jump to the furthest enemy location, damage and knock enemies.

Pounce.name: Pounce
Pounce.description: Dash to closest enemy, deal high damage and get 20% damage done as shield.

CrimsonSpike.name: Crimson Spike
CrimsonSpike.description: Shoot projectile towards the enemy with lowest health. Apply heavy bleed to all enemies it passes through

SerpentDance.name: Serpent Dance
SerpentDance.description: Quickly strikes enemies in medium range 10 times. Inflict Poison. Apply shield for each unique enemy hit.

DragonTail.name: Dragon Tail
DragonTail.description: Strikes in a straight line towards closest enemy in long range. Deal damage to all enemies hit. Grants a shield.

ToxicPool.name: Toxic Pool
ToxicPool.description: Spawns pool under the closest enemy that deals periodic damage, slows and applies poison.
ToxicPool.level1: 4 damage per second. 35% slow. 4 damage/s poison for 10s. Duration 3 seconds
ToxicPool.level2: 10 damage per second. 45% slow. 7 damage/s poison for 10s. Duration 3 seconds
ToxicPool.level3: 20 damage per second. 60% slow. 12 damage/s poison for 10s. Duration 3 seconds
